data.situation:
At three, a visitor approached the lost-property desk without his blue backpack. He remembered leaving it by the sports fence. Jo asked when he had last seen it, then went to investigate. For security, found valuables were kept in a locked cupboard, and Maya waited beside it. A volunteer had noticed a suspicious-looking bag near the garden gate, but had not opened it. They compared the description and called the activity leader. The leader had moved the blue backpack to the theatre desk while clearing the path. Jo collected it and asked the visitor to identify the key ring clipped to a strap before returning the bag. Afterwards, Maya helped secure the other found bags in the cupboard. The visitor checked his pockets once more, then put the backpack over both shoulders. Visitor: ‘I thought someone had taken it.’
Jo: ‘We needed to investigate where it had gone. The activity leader moved it to the theatre desk.’
Visitor: ‘So nobody reported a crime?’
Jo: ‘No crime was reported in this case. We found the bag after checking the two desks. Here is your key ring; is this the one you described?’

readingBlocks.en: At three, a visitor approached the lost-property desk without his blue backpack. He remembered leaving it by the sports fence. Jo asked when he had last seen it, then went to investigate. For security, found valuables were kept in a locked cupboard, and Maya waited beside it. A volunteer had noticed a suspicious-looking bag near the garden gate, but had not opened it. They compared the description and called the activity leader. The leader had moved the blue backpack to the theatre desk while clearing the path. Jo collected it and asked the visitor to identify the key ring clipped to a strap before returning the bag. Afterwards, Maya helped secure the other found bags in the cupboard. The visitor checked his pockets once more, then put the backpack over both shoulders.
readingBlocks.zh: 三点，一位访客没带着他的蓝色背包来到失物柜台。他记得把包留在运动场围栏旁。乔问他最后看见包是什么时候，然后去了解情况。玛雅在锁着的柜子旁等候，这个柜子用来保障拾到的贵重物品安全。一位志愿者发现花园门边有个让人生疑的包，但没有打开。他们比对了描述，联系活动负责人。负责人清理小路时，把蓝色背包移到了剧场柜台。乔取回背包，让访客辨认扣在包带上的钥匙圈，才把包交还。之后，玛雅帮忙把其他拾到的包锁进柜子妥善保管。访客又检查了一遍口袋，接着把背包背在双肩上。

readingBlocks.en:
Visitor: ‘I thought someone had taken it.’
Jo: ‘We needed to investigate where it had gone. The activity leader moved it to the theatre desk.’
Visitor: ‘So nobody reported a crime?’
Jo: ‘No crime was reported in this case. We found the bag after checking the two desks. Here is your key ring; is this the one you described?’
readingBlocks.zh:
访客：“我以为有人把它拿走了。”
乔：“我们需要查清它去了哪里。活动负责人把它移到了剧场柜台。”
访客：“所以没人报案说发生了犯罪？”
乔：“这次没有人报告犯罪。我们核对两处柜台后找到了包。这是你的钥匙圈，是你描述的那个吗？”

glossary.note: 不可数名词；for security 表示为保障物品安全，不是保安人员。
glossary.example: Found valuables were kept in a locked cupboard for security.
glossary.exampleZh: 拾到的贵重物品被放在锁着的柜子里，以保障安全。

externalEvidence.definition: the state of being free from danger or injury

glossary.note: 动词 secure；本句把拾到的包锁进柜子保护，不是安全的形容词。
glossary.example: Maya helped secure the other found bags in the cupboard.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅帮忙把其他拾到的包锁进柜子妥善保管。

glossary.note: suspicious-looking 描述包引起疑虑的样子，不证明有人犯罪；本句不讲某人心里感到怀疑的另一方向。
glossary.example: A volunteer noticed a suspicious-looking bag near the garden gate.
glossary.exampleZh: 一位志愿者发现花园门边有个让人生疑的包。

glossary.note: investigate where it had gone 表示查明它去了哪里；investigate 后可以接问题从句。
glossary.example: Jo went to investigate where the backpack had gone.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔去查找背包去了哪里。

externalEvidence.definition: conduct an inquiry or investigation of

glossary.note: 名词 crime；本句只转述这次事件没有报告犯罪，不由失物直接认定犯罪。
glossary.example: No crime was reported in this case.

externalEvidence.definition: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
